unit.why: A short anecdote about R. Abraham Joshua Heschel of Apt (the Ohev Yisrael): his habitual saying on love of Israel and his deathbed instruction to his sons that only 'Ohev Yisrael' be inscribed on his tombstone, which was carried out. It is a minimal narrative inside a numbered list of his virtues.
unit.boundary_note: item (ה) of a numbered list of the tsaddik's levels; the list continues in the next division

stories.summary_en: The Apter Rav used to say that he could boast of his love of Israel even before the heavenly court, and before his death he ordered his sons to inscribe no praise on his tombstone except 'Ohev Yisrael', which was done.
